topic.title: 비즈니스 문의 메일 작성
topic.description: 비즈니스 파트너에게 제품이나 서비스에 대한 정보를 문의하는 이메일을 작성하는 방법을 배웁니다.

korean_scripts.korean_text: 저희는 귀사의 신제품 카탈로그에 대해 문의드리고자 합니다.
해당 제품의 가격표와 상세 사양을 받아볼 수 있을까요?
또한, 견본 제공이 가능한지 여부도 알고 싶습니다.
견적 요청과 관련하여 필요한 절차가 있다면 알려주시면 감사하겠습니다.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: We would like to inquire about your company's new product catalog.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: We would like to inquire | about your company's new product catalog.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Could we receive the price list and detailed specifications for this product?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Could we receive | the price list | and detailed specifications | for this product?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Also, we would like to know about the possibility of sample provision.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Also, | we would like to know | about the possibility of sample provision.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: If there are any necessary procedures for requesting a quotation, we would appreciate it if you could inform us.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: If there are any necessary procedures | for requesting a quotation, | we would appreciate it | if you could inform us.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: We look forward to your prompt reply.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: We look forward to your prompt reply.
